primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The VBR consists of a set of ten images illustrating different degrees of ocular redness, ranging from normal to severe, and each image is assigned a value from 10 (least redness) to 100 (most redness). The bulbar conjunctival injection of the participant's eye (nasal and temporal) was examined via slit-lamp examination and compared to the reference images in the VBR and graded accordingly.
